why: The 2026-09-24 run built the header with a regex substitution whose replacement string contained \g<1> and \g<2> written as literal text rather than expanded group references, so version 46 rendered the characters '\g<1>' and '\g<2>' visibly to the reader and lost the .sub and .txt styling on both blocks entirely. Build the header with plain string replacement, not re.sub, or escape the replacement.
